images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one landscape 1536x1024 editorial photograph. References are actual Himawari No.188L: image1 controls GREY target color, complete bag shape and all hardware; image2 is only the handle connector construction reference in another color, do not use its pink color. Actual external dimensions width28 height39 depth15 cm. A fictional Korean woman about60, in a navy cotton jacket and cream trousers, stands beside a quiet bookshop counter holding the grey backpack by BOTH of its joined grey top handles in one hand at her side. Crop from chest to mid-shin, front three-quarter view, bag occupies about half image height, hand and connector clearly visible, no backpack wearing. Keep exact grey rectangular box shape, two grey handles each with silver rectangular attachment rings and beige stitched X tabs, small beige snap band joining the TWO handles at their center. Front grey flap pouch with two beige straps, silver round snaps and belt buckles, tiny white rectangular vintage Himawari patch/red detail from image1. Main opening CLOSED, beige twin zipper pulls, side pocket and grey padded shoulder straps behind as original. Natural soft window light, honest fabric texture, no text overlay, no fake review. Never lift by just the small snap band, hand wraps both handles. No extra strap, no chest belt, no invented product feature.
